comments.author: fanteeek
comments.body_html:
If your SPT Server is always running on the same machine, then yes, you don’t need FikaSync. Your profiles are always up to date.

All profiles are stored by the person hosting the SPT Server. In the case of a dedicated PC running SPT Server 24/7, all profiles are stored on it. As I said, my friends and I don’t have the ability to keep the server running 24/7, and the friend who was the host doesn’t always have the ability to run the server for us. In this case, my other friends and I can run FikaSync and get our current profiles from the last game session.

I just decided to share this with everyone because I couldn’t find any analogues, and for us, this is a working option. Today, our friend with the most powerful PC is the host, but tomorrow, no one will be online, and I’ll want to play alone. Instead of asking the previous host to send me my profile files, I’ll just run FikaSync.

I hope I’ve answered all your questions :)

comments.author: fanteeek
comments.body_html:
This means that a profile was found in the repository that you don’t have locally on your computer, and it was downloaded.

After you and your friend played a game, and they were the host via FikaSync, they sent all the profiles to the repository when they finished the program.

When you launched FikaSync, it saw that the repository contained profiles that you didn’t have (or that were newer than yours) and replaced them locally so that when you launched the SPT Server, you would have the same progress as after you ended the session with your friend. It’s that simple)

comments.author: fanteeek
comments.body_html: Yes, you’re right. The repository acts as a cloud storage for all profiles. (I chose the repository so my friends wouldn’t have to set anything up or sign in anywhere. I’d set everything up myself, send them the app and the token file, and that’s it.)

comments.author: Sipto
comments.body_html: How it works: FikaSync becomes your new launcher essentially. every time it is booted it pulls the most up to date profiles for all users from GH. If user A always hosts, but user B wants to play on their profile when User A is unavailable, they boot FikaSync which also boots SPT Server and Launcher, then that pulls their up to date profile from when they last played with User A. When they are done playing locally, they can properly close FikaSync’s terminal to update their profile for User A’s FikaSync to receive.
